works.body:
Hello Saki693さん!
I am in love with your compositions!!!
Could I request an illustration of my OCs, Lucius & Youri?
They are a pair of vampiric lovers who live together in a decadent metropolis.

Lucius (177cm) is neither good nor evil.
A devilish man masked by an innocent smile.
His personality is unrealistic, closer to a fairytale dream or an optical illusion.
His nature is tempting, but ultimately inedible like the forbidden fruit.
Motifs: entropy & paradoxes, persimmons & lotuses, leopards & peacocks.

Youri (168 cm) is described as a Victorian maiden.
A tender-hearted person with a warm, caring “aura”.
He hides his lamentations with his compassion, confidence & patience.
He is flat-chested & has no discernible gender.
Motifs: time & permanence, pomegranates & white lilies, butterflies & deer in the headlights.

Lucius & Youri's relationship is lovey-dovey, with a hint of bittersweetness.
They regularly drink each other's blood & investigate the inexplicable, nightmarish realities born from humanity's collective subconscious.
Inspiration: surrealism, apocalypse, the Divine Comedy (神曲) & Bosch's the Last Judgment (最後の審判の三連祭壇画).

I trust in your creative discretion!
Thank you for your consideration!!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1cIbmPZ8-T2c0KVP5ZI9qFUDwwr-9RzKG?usp=drive_link

He has a talkative, mischievous, and sly personality. His usual expression is a big grin.
He is a traveling vampire hunter. His weapon of choice is a traditional stake.
He is proud and defiant.

Gabe
186 cm. Grey haired male. Muscular.
His usual expression is a smile. He has an irreverent and casual personality, but he is also secretly very dangerous.

Please note that he should have his human colored skin and normal ears and no claws.

Either way, thank you so much for reading my request!

Hello! Your art is beautiful, I would love to commission my OC! 

[SIRENE] [173 CM] ♀️ is a beautiful and talented songstress. Like a villainess she is a very vain, prideful, dramatic, selfish and egotistical Prima Donna that will stop at nothing to command attention of the stage. Her voice is so enchanting it can mesmerize any audience. Her persona is that of a Prima Donna, exuding confidence and an almost regal arrogance. She revels in the adoration of her fans, basking in the spotlight and demanding to be the center of attention. Her beauty and charm are matched only by her sharp wit and playful teasing, keeping those around her in a state of constant intrigue. She is manipulative, cunning and power hungry.

Like a siren, she has a very lovely voice that easily draws in crowds, but a deadly disposition. She adores attention, and is constantly teasing others. Secretly, she has a wish to fly free from the demanding lifestyle and insincere adoration. The endless pursuit of perfection and the hollow praise that comes with it have left her feeling trapped. The life of a star, though glamorous, has become a gilded cage. She dreams of a day when she can break free, soaring away from the expectations and pressures that weigh her down, to find a place where she can be truly herself- a wild and adventurous woman, without the need for applause or admiration.

She comes from a family with a bird theme, and thus, her theme is both like that of a caged songbird and a seductive siren. Her favorite thing is diamonds because they are both beautiful and the world's hardest gemstone.

She has light hair and hazel eyes, and always has a mischievous expression on her face. She has a large bust, and two moles under her right eye.

Theme song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QS-QqK5bQtk

I'd love to see her in a dress like this, with the boa resembling feathers. https://imgur.com/a/Pdp7j6A

Feel free to do as you wish, thank you!

The veins of the weapon's flesh appear to be alive and slowly extend over the character's hands. The veins of the blade's flesh seem to smolder slightly and there is little smoke or sparks.

This background can be assumed that the character first came into contact with the weapon in the forbidden treasury when fleeing from an emergency situation, and that the weapon bonded with her body, also granting her the ability to resurrect.
The character seems slightly bewildered, and although she is burned by the flames, she seems to feel strangely confident and secure in the weapon's power.

As for the environment, the treasury should be quite empty. It has not been open for a long time, and as the characters enter, the dust in the air rises, reflecting the light from the door. The outside of the door appears to be burning and crumbling.

Best regards.

Nice to meet you, I saw your beautiful and fantastic pen drawings. I would like you to draw my character if you would like.
I know this is a last-minute request for the deadline, but I would appreciate your consideration.
I would appreciate it if you could draw my character in a weird and dangerous atmosphere, like illustrations of classic game books or fantasy TRPGs.

■Settings
This character's name is Remino, and she is a demon who lives in the demon world.
Originally, she was a female employee working in Japan, but due to a natural cataclysm, she warped into one of the demon worlds.
Normally, humans who crash into the demon world die from the miasma, as they cannot withstand the noxious air. However, she, on the contrary, adapted to the miasma and turned into a demon of snow and ice.
She has since developed her magical powers and her status in the demon world has grown. Her goal is to return to the human world where she used to be and resume her human life, and to prevent the human world from being invaded by tyrannical demons and angels.
However, Remino himself, perhaps because of his demonic instincts, has a predilection for human beings. (In the illustration, his face appears on his chest, but it appears to be a playful reproduction using the soul of a captured human.)
) He can also turn a person he likes into an agitated snowman to serve by his side.

Appearance
His head and torso are made of magical snow, and his arms, legs, horns, and ears are made of ice. The rabbit between its legs has an ego and acts provocatively. However, when it runs out of magical power, it weakens and becomes as shown in the illustration on the right.
The rabbit is reasonably powerful, but not absolutely so. In RPG terms, it is at a level where it cannot compete with the heroes of the final stages of the game.
